decisions.statement: A value is on the disk after the call handing that value over has returned.
`flushed` resolves once every value handed over before that call is on the disk.
Values handed over in one turn reach one file in one append.
Values reach the disk in the order the values were handed over.
Which file a value lands in is settled as that value is handed over.
Which file a value lands in is settled by `page-entry-landing`.
A value handed over after a refusal is written rather than dropped.
`flushed` resolves rather than rejects where a write is refused.
A value that cannot be turned into JSON is refused rather than thrown.
A queue beside a page that is not there is refused rather than made.
`at` names the last of the numbered files this queue writes into.
Nothing here waits on the disk while a value is handed over.
A caller wanting the file this opens claimed files the path `at` answers.
Nothing here has a lock against another writer of the same file.

definition: entry values reaching the disk after the call handing those values over returns
